unstuck_said.text: Filed issue duongnq2798/vestiarion#373: "A Nano (XNO) settlement rail — the block IS the signed ledger entry, feeless". Framed in their own terms — Vestiarion signs every outcome into a hash-chained ledger anyone can verify and pays in USDC on Arc inside a spending-limit contract. A Nano block IS that immutable re-derivable ledger entry, feeless, no facilitator. Proposed Nano as a settle option with the block hash as the signed audit entry. No machine signature.
